figs.name: idmt-relay-trip-time-calculation-flowchart
figs.alt: IDMT relay trip time calculation flowchart from CT ratio and PSM to TMS
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the six steps of the worked example: 400 A pickup, PSM 10, standard inverse constants and a 0.30 s trip at TMS 0.1.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>IDMT relay trip time calculation steps with PSM and TMS</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">IDMT Trip Time: Step by Step Calculation</text>
<rect x="40" y="70" width="220" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150.0" y="112.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Pickup current</text>
<text x="150.0" y="136.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">CT 400/1, plug 100 %</text>
<text x="150.0" y="160.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 400 A</text>
<line x1="262" y1="130" x2="288" y2="130" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="290" y="70" width="220" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="112.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. PSM</text>
<text x="400.0" y="136.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4000 A ÷ 400 A</text>
<text x="400.0" y="160.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 10</text>
<line x1="512" y1="130" x2="538" y2="130" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="540" y="70" width="220" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="650.0" y="112.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Curve constants</text>
<text x="650.0" y="136.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">standard inverse</text>
<text x="650.0" y="160.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">k 0.14, α 0.02</text>
<line x1="650" y1="192" x2="650" y2="258" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="540" y="260" width="220" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="650.0" y="302.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. PSM to the α</text>
<text x="650.0" y="326.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">10 to the power 0.02</text>
<text x="650.0" y="350.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 1.0471</text>
<line x1="538" y1="320" x2="512" y2="320" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="290" y="260" width="220" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fffbeb" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="302.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. Base time</text>
<text x="400.0" y="326.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.14 ÷ 0.0471</text>
<text x="400.0" y="350.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">= 2.97 s</text>
<line x1="288" y1="320" x2="262" y2="320" stroke="#78350f" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="260" width="220" height="120" rx="10" fill="#b45309" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150.0" y="302.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6. Trip time</text>
<text x="150.0" y="326.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">TMS × base time</text>
<text x="150.0" y="350.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0.1 × 2.97 = 0.30 s</text>
<rect x="40" y="405" width="720" height="76" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="436" font-size="20" fill="#78350f" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">t = TMS × k ÷ (PSM to the α minus 1)</text>
<text x="400" y="466" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Same fault: very inverse 0.15 s, extremely inverse 0.081 s</text>
</svg>
